diagram_previews.alt: Six grey circles of radius 8 centred at the vertices of a dashed regular hexagon of side 8. The enclosing curve consists of six red straight segments parallel to the hexagon's sides and six blue arcs; at the right-hand vertex two green radii of length 8 to the ends of its arc form a 60 degree angle.
